preamble: The voiced alveolar fricative [z] becomes the voiced postalveolar fricative [ʒ], with the tongue retracted behind the alveolar ridge. In the Tayart (Aïr Tamajaq) variety of Tuareg, Proto-Berber *z is reflected as ž [ʒ] before the front vowel *i, as in *a-maziɣ 'Berber, freeman' > ămažǝɣ, while it stays z elsewhere.

examples.note: Wikipedia describes Tayart and Tawellemmet as keeping *z as z but turning it into ž [ʒ] before the front vowel *i, hence the name Tamajaq; elsewhere z stays (Tawellemmet eɣăzăr 'valley'). Both dialects also palatalize dentals before /i/ and /j/.
